reviews.comment: BEST professor I have ever had! I wish more professors modeled her teaching style! She gives candy for participation, genuinely cares about her students, adjusts course based on feedback DURING semester, helpful office hours (plz go), writes procedures for you to follow so you know how to do every style of problem, with TAs-explains in-class probs

If you're reading old negative reviews, they're not accurate now. As a #1 physics HATER, I actually found that she was a personable teacher and she could explain Dynamics in a way that was digestible to me. She single-handedly made the content of this course bearable and I love her for that. She's the type of prof who you'd want to be friends with.

She is an awesome teacher! I actually felt like I learned the material well. She works through problems with us in class and during in class activities. The tests are fair and she gives good opportunities to pad your grade with homework and in class work. She gets to know her students as people. Her lectures are engaging and she gives out candy.

The class in general is hard but she does a great job of lecturing and caring that students learn. There are in class exercises every class that are easy 95-100s and make up a good portion of the grade.

I don't think I've ever had a professor as great as Dr. Paal. She is super passionate and knowledgeable about this course and will do everything and anything to make sure you succeed in her class. Homeworks and in-class work may be thought-provoking but she is there to make sure you are on the right track. Overall, she is a great professor.
Steph is a girls girl and got me through the semester. She gives you candy if you ask questions. You should take her.

Dr. Paal is a great professor and a great mentor. She makes lectures fun and also understandable. She is very open to feedback and is willing to shift her teaching to match the students she has for that term and is very accessible outside of class. Overall, one of my favorite professors at A&M and someone I consider a mentor.
She has access to lots of materials but she does not discuss anything in the class. All the students will take a lecture and she would grade them based on their presentation skills

Dr. Paal is awesome! She really cares for her students and enjoys teaching. From day one she made it a point to learn each of our names and got to know us as individuals. She fostered a fun and interactive learning environment a was always willing to answer any questions and help us when needed. I would highly recommend her as a professor.
Dr. Paal was amazing. If you really want to learn the content her teaching methods are amazing!
Its a hard class, however Professor Paal does a great job of explaining the material in class and making you understand the material by giving co.ncept checks

If you are ready to pay to teach to yourself, please go ahead and take this class. Prof. Paal does nothing but expects students to read and then present to the class. One of the worst profs I ever had.

Dr. Paal is kind and tries to help you when you need it, but with the online format during COVID she made it more difficult. During exams, you couldn't have your zoom screen up besides asking supervision during the submission process (or else you get a 0) so you couldn't ask typical exam questions as you could in class, but she grades very fairly.

Dr. Paal is definitely an expert. Great mentor if you are on the structural track. But, with that being said, she gives a lot of very long homework . She often explain things way over your head. She expects a lot, maybe too much, from her students. Be prepared to devote a lot of time in your week to this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: One of the best Prof's I've had at A&M. Truly cares about her students, knows the material, and is always available in office hours. Homework is challenging, but tests are fair.

One of the worst professors I ever had. She is terrible at explaining things in class and offers little to no help when approached. She brags about how hard her exams are and how hard the homework is. Do not take her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: It seems as if Dr. Paal is seeing the information for the first time as she is lecturing. Professor Paal constantly makes mistakes during lecture which makes the concepts more difficult to comprehend. Even while visiting her office hours she completely led me astray while trying to understand a test question. She does not belong in a classroom.
